preprocess_wikipedia_documents: run the preprocess step to load all Wikipedia documents from the knowledge source and store them as pickled chunks
run_main_chunking_pipeline: run the main step to chunk Wikipedia documents into paragraphs using spaCy NLP with configurable token chunk size
merge_jsonl_output_files: run the merge step to combine all per-rank JSONL output files into a single kilt.jsonl file
create_chunk_from_tokens: create a chunk dictionary from a token buffer with adjusted anchor offsets for a given paragraph and section
run_thread_on_document_batch: run a threaded NLP processing pass over a batch of documents to produce paragraph chunks with anchors
